senses.gloss: (cmp. אִיסְטְמָא) hair-net, a cap worn under the head-dress.
units: Sabb. VI, 1; 5.—Y. ib. 7ᵈ ולא בכבולי טבזסה, read: ולא בכ׳ שבכה ‘and not in a Kabul’ (Mish. l. c.), that is a hair-net. Bab. ib. 57ᵇ כ׳ זה איני יודע אי וכ׳ this Kabul (Mish. l. c.) I do not know whether it means a slave’s chain &c.
